_readme: Machine-checked by tools/tests/test_cross_ref_integrity.py. Read tools/apfguard/ledger.py before editing. Every SHA is verified against git: a branch that moves invalidates its row.

_dispositions.AWAITING_HUMAN_DECISION: Recorded, unresolved, and not the guard's to decide.
_dispositions.PR_OPEN: Divergence tracked by an open pull request.
_dispositions.PUSHED_AFTER_MERGE: Commits exist on a branch whose pull request already merged.
_dispositions.RESOLVED: Do not use — remove the row instead. The ledger retires its own rows.

claimants: Evidence gate on architecture contract promotion and implementation start
Run falsification benchmark v0.1 and v0.2 as parallel tracks
Unify benchmark identifiers on BENCH-* and consolidate the research document set
DEC-0001.note: Three different decisions carry this id: doc consolidation (main), evidence gate (PR #4), parallel benchmark tracks (PR #3). Two are marked DECIDED. Renumbering is not a records fix — it changes which decision every citation of DEC-0001 resolves to. The owner must pick the surviving DEC-0001 and reissue the others.

claimants: Claim records are completed individually at benchmark preparation time
Resolve the gap between the claim quality gate and inventory practice
DEC-0002.note: Two decisions on claim-record completeness, PR #3 and PR #4, same id, neither on main. Resolve together with DEC-0001.

BENCH-0001.note: BENCHMARK_REGISTER on main says UNTESTED. PR #4 holds a preregistered execution (preregistration e3dd94c, execution 51b1ebc) reporting CLM-0001 falsifier F4 fired. Claim states are not changed by this guard; the register is wrong or the execution is not accepted, and only the owner can say which.

BENCH-0006.note: BENCHMARK_REGISTER on main says UNTESTED and SESSION_STATE lists BENCH-0006 as the next action. PR #3 holds an execution dated 2026-09-02 with a harness and raw results. The next action recorded on main has already been done elsewhere.

BENCH-0004 R3.note: Two different experiments are both named BENCH-0004 Round 3, run about an hour apart on 2026-09-02, reaching opposite conclusions. main: 21-doc APF corpus, CLM-0004, D4 -0.135, 'broad claim falsified'. PR #4: 737 third-party PEPs, CLM-0011, D4 +0.124 CI [+0.044,+0.204]. main's own risk register asks for the independent corpus that PR #4 already used. Distinct claims and metrics, so not a direct contradiction — but one identifier cannot name both.
